advancements.error404.root.description: The world you joined is no longer being saved.

advancements.error404.first_signal.descr: Pick up a Corrupt Shard - something in this world is already broken.

advancements.error404.ending_null.title: 0x00
advancements.error404.ending_null.descri: Look at it three times. It remembers.
